observations: All eight current views are explicitly marked “Missing display parts: slanted_back_panel,” and the supplied render status independently lists slanted_back_panel as missing because its evaluated mesh is degenerate.

The remaining displayed assembly retains two full-height side panels and three distinct horizontal shelves. The frontal views (attachments 1 and 4) remain broadly symmetric, while oblique views 2, 3, 5, and 6 show the shelf ends supported between the side panels.

The current evidence supersedes the earlier appearance-only diagnosis that the back panel’s existing -7° lean was merely difficult to see: in these renders the entire slanted_back_panel is omitted, so neither its presence nor its required visible inclination is preserved.
The displayed geometry remains monochromatic matte black, but weak separation from the nearly black background continues to obscure panel and shelf boundaries.
Dimensions, connection topology, fit allowance, mate-frame validity, and the six-part assignment cannot be visually certified from these partial diagnostic renders.
